title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse stories, from a Beer Sheva sale to a Barcelona debut.

questions.question: Which European club is Kings Kangwa reported to be joining on a four-year deal after Hapoel Beer Sheva agreed to sell him?
questions.explanation: Panathinaikos' offer beat a rival bid from AEK Athens, with Kangwa signing a four-year deal running to summer 2030.

questions.question: Former Maccabi Tel Aviv guard Alex Garcia extended his contract with which Brazilian club, a deal Sport5 says will keep him playing until at least age 47?
questions.explanation: Garcia, who has played for Bauru Basket since 2014, signed the extension to enter his 12th season with the club.

questions.question: In which city did Israel's Under-16 girls' water polo team open the World Aquatics Women's U16 Championship on July 25, 2026?
questions.explanation: The championship runs July 25-31, 2026 at Zagreb's Mladost swimming and water polo centre, where Israel opened against South Africa and Hungary.

questions.question: 17-year-old Oryan Goren, who joined Barcelona's academy from Maccabi Petah Tikva in 2023, made his first-team debut in a preseason friendly against which opponent?
questions.explanation: Goren came on as a substitute as Barcelona won the closed-doors friendly 4-1 against CE Europa at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper.

questions.question: Which Israeli club gave defender Chibuike Nwaiwu an unsuccessful trial roughly three and a half years before Fulham agreed personal terms with him?
questions.explanation: Nwaiwu trialled unsuccessfully with Bnei Sakhnin, who did not sign him, before his career led to a reported €27-30m move to Fulham.
